label: Today
headline: Know your next move.
description: Your day is already laid out. Open Today, see what is happening now, and give your attention to one activity at a time.
steps: Tap an activity for its notes, goal and videos.
Mark it done or skipped. Undo if you need to.
benefits: A live timeline keeps the next step visible.
Your output, notes and chosen lessons stay with the activity.
Completion is an honest record, without a streak to protect.
details: Current and upcoming activity
Connected, numbered timeline
Done, skipped and undo controls
Full activity details and playable video links
Daily completion count and progress
Plan Today when you have not planned yet

label: Plan
headline: Give your day a clear finish line.
description: A routine gives you the shape. A plan adds the specifics: what you will finish, the notes you need, and the lessons you will actually watch.
steps: Start with the routine matched to today's or tomorrow's weekday.
Choose videos, write an output and add notes for each activity.
Finalize the activities, review the summary and lock the day.
benefits: Weekday matching saves rebuilding the same day.
A clear output turns 'study' into something you can finish.
Locking the plan ends the cycle of constant rearranging.
details: Plans today first if today is unplanned, otherwise tomorrow
Automatic weekday routine selection or manual choice
Routine changes refresh unlocked drafts; manual reload is available
Choose a course and select individual lessons or chunks
Editable output and notes; routine controls time, title and area
Finalize one activity at a time
Hours and activity count before the three-step day confirmation
An 18-hour cap and overlap checks

label: Library
headline: Keep the useful parts. Reuse them.
description: Library is your collection of reusable building blocks. Areas group your life, routines shape your week, and videos keep your learning in one place.
steps: Add a few areas, such as Study, Work and Training.
Create a routine with timed activities and choose its weekdays.
Optionally add YouTube courses to use in your plans.
benefits: A color and a name make each priority easy to recognize.
Copy an existing routine and change only what is different.
Turn a long course into manageable lessons or video chunks.
details: Search, create, edit and delete routines

Set each activity's time, title, area and default course

Multiple playlists and individual videos per area
Paste YouTube links and load public lesson metadata
Split long videos into chunks of your chosen length
Browse lessons in pages and keep completion progress
Copy links, reload courses and clear imported items
Choose the relevant course when an area has several

label: Reminders
headline: Walk in. Remember why you came.
description: Milk at the supermarket. A book at the library. Put the task with the place, so arriving can bring it back to mind.
steps: Search a place, tap the map or use your current location.
Name it, choose a radius and save. Attach a reminder to it.
Get an arrival alert. Tick the task when it is done.
benefits: Choose the actual place on a map, not just an address in a note.
An unfinished task stays attached to its place.
Repeat nudges help while you are there, until completion or exit.
details: Separate Locations and Reminders tabs
Place search with suggestions
Tap the map or drag the pin to choose coordinates
Use your current position; zoom and recenter

Save a location name and address

label: Settings
headline: Make it feel like your app.
description: Choose your theme, set how early block alerts arrive, and keep a backup of the routines you have built. The useful controls, in one place.
steps: Set your name, photo and light or dark theme.
Allow notifications; enable location access for arrival reminders.
Check your latest backup or tap Back Up Now.
benefits: Choose the heads-up you need before activities start and end.
Keep your saved day available even when you lose signal.
Restore backed-up work when you sign in again.

label: Sign in
headline: One email code. Your own space.
description: You do not need a perfect system to begin. Sign in, add one area, and make a short routine for a day you recognize.
steps: Enter your email and request a sign-in code.
Enter the six-digit code from your inbox.
Start in Library with one area and a simple routine.
benefits: Your backed-up data belongs to your account.
Start with just a few activities and build from there.
